text:
mina: vault audit alerted on multiple unwraps of ciphertext wrapped with `projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cmek-shadow` by principal unknown-service@partner at 02:04 UTC. looks like a recent IAM change.
kai: link to vault audit entry? can we see the wrapped blob metadata and the service account used to call KMS?
mina: pasted snippet:
```
user: unknown-service@partner
action: transit.unwrap
key_alias: cmek-shadow
time: 2026-03-25T02:04:12Z
client_ip: 35.196.12.8
```
ethan: cross-checking GCP admin audit - found a SetIamPolicy on that key at 2026-03-24T23:58Z. principal: vendor-sync@partner. policy change was missing any IAM condition.
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly: vendor principal granted roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter (unconditioned). Recommend immediate containment: snapshot key policy, revoke binding, and list dependent resources (Vault transit mounts, GCS buckets, CMEK-enabled snapshots).
sec-ops: containment plan: 1) create ephemeral ops-sa with limited kms/cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to perform rewraps 2) revoke vendor binding 3) identify wrapped blobs in Vault and rewrap to new key 4) rotate any service tokens and database credentials.
infra-oncall: be mindful: some scheduled backups use that key; full revoke will pause backups. propose canary revoke on a single noncritical resource first.
mina: I've initiated an export of 30d audit for the key: https://logs.internal/exports/cmek-shadow-440500.json :lock:
kai: enumerating dependent resources:
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:cmek-shadow" --format=json
```
Results: vault-transit-payments, snapshots-db-2025, backups-logs-prod, analytics-export-bucket, payment-worker-fn.
ethan: partner claims the change was from their config sync; their logs show a terraform import step then an apply. but the terraform state did not include conditional IAM binding. possible gap in onboarding terraform modules.
rotor-bot: created incident INC-2026-072: cmek-shadow-vendor-bind. Paging sec-ops and infra.
sec-ops: executing staged revoke: - grant ephemeral ops-sa to rewrap - revoke vendor binding - run rewrap on low-risk resources - smoke tests - proceed to remaining resources.
infra-oncall: rewrap command running:
```
./scripts/rewrap_kms --src cmek-shadow --dst cmek-shadow-rot-20260325 --resources ./cmek-shadow-resources.json --parallel 5
```
mina: canary at 4405003550: payment-worker-fn rotated and passed health checks.
ethan: one Vault transit mount referenced the old key via alias; updated alias and restarted transit plugin. no unwraps observed from vendor afterward.
kai: post-actions: 1) increase KMS audit retention to 180d for prod 2) add alerting rule for cross-project/vendor grants without IAM conditions 3) update vendor onboarding terraform module to enforce conditional bindings and require PR review + automated terratest.
sec-ops: scheduling a vendor onboarding review meeting. will produce a blameless postmortem and add checklist items: - terraform-locked IAM changes only - require ephemeral SA pattern for partner integrations - regular vendor access reviews.
mina: incident open until all rotations finish and vendor root-cause verified. thanks for fast responses everyone :thumbsup:
